user.title: Add a list
user.description: To Get keeps a list of things you need to buy, get or order, and where each one is coming from.

data_description.name: Shown on the card and used to name the to-do list, such as To get or Hardware.
data_description.icon: Shown on the card and the to-do list.

error.name_taken: There's already a list with that name.

data_description.icon: Shown on the card and the to-do list.

add.name: Add
add.description: Put something on the list, with where it's coming from. Something already on the list isn't added twice.

place.name: Place
place.description: Where it's coming from, such as a shop or online. Left out, it's the place it came from last time, if it's been on the list before.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Anything else worth knowing, such as a size or a brand.
